content.comment_body: I have a [product_name] [version_no] in which I inserted a microSD card with .bin files intended for a firmware update. The device powered on, restarted several times, and then stopped working completely.

Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. Please note this is an English-speaking forum, so kindly write your future posts in English. Thank you. Please provide the following details: - Which specific firmware update did you attempt? - Which [product_name] do you have (exact order number and firmware version)?

analysis.insight_summary: A user tried to update the firmware on a [product_name] [version_no] using a microSD card with .bin files. After the attempt, the device became unresponsive, hinting at a possible firmware update failure or hardware issue. The sequence described suggests the update process was disrupted, resulting in total device non-functionality.
